newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN told to close Turkish banks' accounts.
newsitem.headline: ABN told to close Turkish banks' accounts.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Tuesday it was closing accounts held by representative offices in the Netherlands of some unnamed Turkish banks at the request of the Dutch authorities.

ABN AMRO spokesman Jules Prast said the Dutch central bank and Justice Department had said the Turkish banks' offices may have breached banking regulations by collecting money from clients and depositing them in their accounts at ABN AMRO.
Under Dutch law, representative offices of banks are not allowed to carry out banking business as they do not hold the necessary banking licences.
